meaning.en: Living frugally cultivates good character.
meaning.zh: 节俭可以培养品德。

examples.zh: 家训教导子孙要俭以养德。
examples.en: The family precepts teach descendants that thrift nurtures virtue.

examples.zh: 俭以养德，孩子从小就该学会节约。
examples.en: Thrift builds character; children should learn to economise from a young age.

story.en: Zhuge Liang advised his son: 'Stillness cultivates the self; frugality nurtures virtue' (静以修身，俭以养德).
story.zh: 诸葛亮《诫子书》：“夫君子之行，静以修身，俭以养德。”

meaning.en: Times and circumstances have changed.
meaning.zh: 时代变了，情况也随着变化。

equivalents: things are no longer what they were

examples.zh: 时移世易，当年的做法已经不适用了。
examples.en: Times have changed; the old approach no longer applies.

examples.zh: 时移世易，老街早已面目全非。
examples.en: With the passing of time, the old street is unrecognisable.

natural: a couple who have weathered hardship

meaning.en: A couple who have stood by each other through hard times.
meaning.zh: 共同经历过艰难困苦的夫妻。

examples.zh: 他们是患难夫妻，感情特别深。
examples.en: They are a couple who have weathered hardship, and their bond is deep.

examples.zh: 患难夫妻不离不弃，让人感动。
examples.en: The couple who stood by each other through hard times moves everyone.

natural: raise the family's status, or switch allegiance

meaning.en: To raise one's family status; also to switch allegiance or school.
meaning.zh: 改变家族的社会地位；也指改投别家或别的门派。

examples.zh: 他寒窗苦读，想靠科举改换门庭。
examples.en: He studied hard, hoping the exams would raise his family's standing.

examples.zh: 这位画家后来改换门庭，转投另一派。
examples.en: The painter later changed camps and joined another school.

usage.zh: 多作谓语，有两种含义，视语境而定。

natural: play with fire and get burnt

meaning.en: To burn oneself by playing with fire; ruin oneself through risky or evil schemes.
meaning.zh: 玩火的人反而烧了自己，比喻冒险害人，结果害了自己。

examples.zh: 你这样铤而走险，只会玩火自焚。
examples.en: Taking such risks will only get you burnt.

examples.zh: 侵略者终将玩火自焚。
examples.en: Aggressors will in the end burn themselves.

story.en: 'Warfare is like fire; if it is not stopped, it will burn the one who wields it' (夫兵犹火也，弗戢，将自焚也).
story.zh: 《左传·隐公四年》：“夫兵犹火也，弗戢，将自焚也。”

synonyms: 常在河边走，哪有不湿鞋

meaning.en: To make up for a crime or fault by good deeds.
meaning.zh: 带着罪名立下功劳来赎罪。

examples.zh: 他主动交代，争取戴罪立功。
examples.en: He confessed voluntarily, hoping to atone by good service.

examples.zh: 这次任务就是你戴罪立功的机会。
examples.en: This mission is your chance to redeem yourself.

usage.zh: 多作谓语，书面或法律语境。

meaning.en: To treat others with courtesy and respect.
meaning.zh: 用礼貌的态度对待别人。

examples.zh: 对待客人要以礼相待。
examples.en: Guests must be treated with courtesy.

examples.zh: 即使是对手，他也以礼相待。
examples.en: He treats even his rivals with courtesy.

meaning.en: To cut off the beginning and end; to take only the middle part.
meaning.zh: 去掉开头和末尾，只取中间部分。

examples.zh: 这篇文章掐头去尾，只摘了中间几段。
examples.en: The article had its start and end cut, with only a few middle paragraphs excerpted.

examples.zh: 鱼要掐头去尾再下锅。
examples.en: Cut off the fish's head and tail before cooking.

meaning.en: Unwavering until death.
meaning.zh: 到死也不改变。

examples.zh: 他对祖国的热爱至死不渝。
examples.en: His love for his homeland endured until death.

examples.zh: 他们的爱情至死不渝。
examples.en: Their love remained unchanged until death.

meaning.en: Having everything imaginable.
meaning.zh: 什么都有，应有尽有。

examples.zh: 这个市场的商品无所不有。
examples.en: The market has every kind of goods.

examples.zh: 图书馆里的资料无所不有。
examples.en: The library holds materials on everything.

meaning.en: A person on whom the nation relies.
meaning.zh: 能担负重任、为国家依靠的人才。

examples.zh: 青年是国家栋梁，肩负着未来。
examples.en: Young people are the pillars of the nation, carrying its future.

examples.zh: 老师希望学生都成为国家栋梁。
examples.en: The teacher hopes all her students will become pillars of the nation.

meaning.en: To win the trust of others.
meaning.zh: 获得别人的信任。

examples.zh: 说话算数，才能取信于人。
examples.en: Only by keeping your word can you win people's trust.

examples.zh: 企业要靠质量取信于人。
examples.en: A company must earn trust through quality.

usage.en: Predicate; often 才能取信于人.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常说“才能取信于人”。

meaning.en: Talking on and on in a tiresome way.
meaning.zh: 说个没完，让人心烦。

examples.zh: 妈妈总是唠唠叨叨，让我耳朵起茧。
examples.en: Mum keeps nagging on until my ears are sore.

examples.zh: 他一边干活一边唠唠叨叨。
examples.en: He kept muttering on as he worked.

meaning.en: A friend made through shared hardship.
meaning.zh: 在困难中结下的深厚友谊。

examples.zh: 我们是患难之交，彼此信得过。
examples.en: We're friends through thick and thin and trust each other.

examples.zh: 患难之交才是真朋友。
examples.en: A friend in need is a friend indeed.

antonyms: 酒肉朋友千个有，落难之中无一人

meaning.en: Stop! Spare this person's life.
meaning.zh: 请手下留情，别杀这个人。

examples.zh: 法场上有人高喊：“刀下留人！”
examples.en: Someone at the execution ground shouted: 'Spare his life!'

examples.zh: 律师为他争取刀下留人的机会。
examples.en: The lawyer fought for the chance to spare his life.

usage.en: Shouted or in stories and legal contexts.
usage.zh: 多作呼喊语，见于故事或法律语境。

meaning.en: Clouds rising and rosy glow spreading in splendour.
meaning.zh: 云气蒸腾，彩霞绚丽，形容景色绚烂。

examples.zh: 山间云蒸霞蔚，美不胜收。
examples.en: Clouds and rosy mists swirl in the mountains in breathtaking beauty.

examples.zh: 日出时分，天空云蒸霞蔚。
examples.en: At sunrise the sky is ablaze with colourful clouds.

story.en: Gu Kaizhi described the scenery of Kuaiji: 'Thousand crags compete in beauty... like clouds rising and rosy mists blooming' (若云兴霞蔚).
story.zh: 《世说新语·言语》：“千岩竞秀，万壑争流，草木蒙笼其上，若云兴霞蔚。”

meaning.en: To give up on oneself and let things get worse.
meaning.zh: 明知有了缺点或错误，索性任其发展，不再自我约束。

examples.zh: 考砸了也别破罐破摔，下次还有机会。
examples.en: Even if you flopped, don't give up on yourself; there will be another chance.

examples.zh: 他破罐破摔，干脆不上班了。
examples.en: He gave up altogether and simply stopped going to work.

synonyms: 死猪不怕开水烫——满不在乎
antonyms: 留得青山在，不怕没柴烧

natural: all kinds of monsters and demons

meaning.en: Evil forces of all sorts; also absurd, bizarre phenomena.
meaning.zh: 比喻各种丑恶的人或荒诞虚幻的事物。

examples.zh: 别让网络上的牛鬼蛇神带坏了孩子。
examples.en: Don't let the monsters and demons online lead children astray.

examples.zh: 这部小说里牛鬼蛇神，应有尽有。
examples.en: The novel is filled with ghouls and demons of every kind.

story.en: Du Mu on Li He's poetry: 'Whales' gaping and turtles' toss, ox-ghosts and snake-spirits, cannot match its wild fantasy' (鲸呿鳌掷，牛鬼蛇神，不足为其虚荒诞幻也).
story.zh: 杜牧《李贺集序》：“鲸呿鳌掷，牛鬼蛇神，不足为其虚荒诞幻也。”

natural: having worked hard and achieved much

meaning.en: Having laboured hard and rendered great service.
meaning.zh: 付出了很多辛苦，立下了很大功劳。

examples.zh: 老厂长劳苦功高，大家都敬重他。
examples.en: The old factory director gave long and valuable service, and everyone respects him.

examples.zh: 他在公司劳苦功高，却从不邀功。
examples.en: He toiled and achieved much for the company but never claimed credit.

story.en: Fan Kuai said of Liu Bang: 'He toiled hard and achieved great merit, yet was not rewarded with a fief' (劳苦而功高如此，未有封侯之赏).
story.zh: 《史记·项羽本纪》：“劳苦而功高如此，未有封侯之赏。”

meaning.en: Strong soldiers and sturdy horses; a powerful army.
meaning.zh: 士兵强悍，战马雄壮，形容军队实力强大。

examples.zh: 对方兵强马壮，我们不可轻敌。
examples.en: The enemy is strong and well-equipped; we mustn't underestimate them.

examples.zh: 球队兵强马壮，夺冠呼声很高。
examples.en: The team is strong and well-resourced, and tipped to win the title.

meaning.en: There are records that can be checked.
meaning.zh: 有档案或记录可以查证。

examples.zh: 这笔款项的去向有案可查。
examples.en: The destination of this payment is on record.

examples.zh: 所有投诉都有案可查。
examples.en: All complaints are on file and can be checked.

pinyin: yǒu zhì zhě shì jìng chéng
literal: have · will · person · matter · finally · succeed
natural: where there's a will, there's a way

meaning.en: A person with determination will eventually succeed.
meaning.zh: 有决心的人，事情终究能成功。

equivalents: where there's a will there's a way

examples.zh: 有志者事竟成，只要坚持就有希望。
examples.en: Where there's a will there's a way; as long as you persevere there's hope.

examples.zh: 他靠着有志者事竟成的信念，考上了大学。
examples.en: Believing that determination wins out, he got into university.

story.en: Emperor Guangwu told Geng Yan: 'Where there is a will, the thing is accomplished in the end' (有志者事竟成也).
story.zh: 《后汉书·耿弇传》：光武帝对耿弇说：“有志者事竟成也。”

synonyms: 天下无难事，只怕有心人
只要功夫深，铁杵磨成针
有志者，事竟成，破釜沉舟，百二秦关终属楚；苦心人，天不负，卧薪尝胆，三千越甲可吞吴

meaning.en: To put the public interest before personal interest.
meaning.zh: 先考虑集体利益，后考虑个人利益。

examples.zh: 干部应该先公后私，处处带头。
examples.en: Officials should put the public before the private and lead by example.

examples.zh: 他凡事先公后私，赢得了大家的尊重。
examples.en: He always puts the public good first, which won everyone's respect.
